seo.title: About Atlaxys — An engineering-led technology consultancy from Morocco
seo.description: Atlaxys Consulting is a Morocco-based technology consultancy and software engineering studio working with clients worldwide. Our story, how we work and what we refuse to do.

hero.title: Consulting that ends in working software.
hero.lead: Atlaxys started from a simple observation: too much technology advice stops at the slide deck. So we built a company where the people who advise you are the people who build the system — and stay accountable for it in production.

story.title: Built in Morocco. Built for anywhere.
paragraphs: Atlaxys Consulting is a technology consulting and software engineering company based in Morocco. We work with founders, SMEs and established organisations that need software to do real work: platforms their customers use every day, tools their teams depend on, and automations that remove hours of manual effort each week.

Morocco is our home and an increasingly serious place to build technology — a growing engineering talent pool, deep ties to Europe and Africa, and a working culture that moves easily between English, French and Arabic. We serve Moroccan businesses directly, and we work with international companies that want an engineering partner close to them in time zone and in culture.

We are deliberately engineering-led. Every engagement is run by people who write code, design infrastructure and answer for what happens in production. That is what we mean by consulting that ends in working software.

engagement.title: Three ways to engage.
engagement.intro: Pick the model that fits the stage you are at. Many clients start with one and move to another as the product grows.

items.title: Project
items.text: A defined outcome with a written scope, milestones and a fixed or capped budget.
items.bestFor: New products, migrations and well-understood builds.

items.title: Product team
items.text: A dedicated Atlaxys team working as an extension of yours, month to month, on your roadmap.
items.bestFor: Evolving roadmaps where speed and continuity matter.

items.title: Advisory
items.text: Architecture reviews, technical audits and CTO-level guidance, a few days each month.
items.bestFor: Teams that build in-house and want senior technical judgement.

refusals.title: Things we refuse to do.
items: Sell you a platform you do not need.
Hide important decisions inside the codebase.
Hold your code, data or accounts hostage.
Ship something we would not be comfortable running ourselves.

cta.title: Let's see if we are a fit.
cta.text: A 30-minute conversation is usually enough to know whether we can help — and if we cannot, we will say so and point you somewhere better.
